changes.name: EnergyPickupFeedback
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local gui=player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("EnergyUI")
local stats=player:WaitForChild("leaderstats")
local energy=stats:WaitForChild("Energy")
local last=energy.Value

local function popup(delta)
	if delta<=0 then return end
	local t=Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
	t.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,.5,35)
	t.Size=UDim2.new(0,190,0,55)
	t.BackgroundTransparency=1
	t.Text="+"..delta.." ENERGY"
	t.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,225,85)
	t.TextStrokeTransparency=.35
	t.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
	t.TextSize=27
	t.Parent=gui
	local tw=TweenService:Create(t,TweenInfo.new(.7,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{
		Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,.5,-25),TextTransparency=1,TextStrokeTransparency=1
	})
	tw:Play()
	tw.Completed:Connect(function() t:Destroy() end)
end

energy:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
	local now=energy.Value
	popup(now-last)
	last=now
end)

changes.name: EnergyOrbEffects
changes.source:
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")

local function animate(orb)
	if not orb:IsA("BasePart") or orb.Name~="EnergyOrb" then return end
	local start=orb.Position
	local phase=math.random()*math.pi*2
	task.spawn(function()
		while orb.Parent do
			local y=math.sin(os.clock()*2.4+phase)*.7
			orb.Position=Vector3.new(start.X,start.Y+y,start.Z)
			orb.Orientation+=Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)
			task.wait(.03)
		end
	end)
end

for _,v in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do animate(v) end
world.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v)
	task.wait()
	animate(v)
end)
